_comment: Speech-only PCM MD5 hashes of known degraded/quota-limit Homeway responses. Confirmed entries were captured directly from HA's own config/tts cache (pre-chime, exactly what the runtime check hashes) - no trimming/derivation needed for these. Add more the same way: pull the raw file straight from config/tts right after reproducing a limit-hit, before it gets cleared.
765f2f69cde8b0422c2c8f1ab7fa07a1: Homeway limit/quota response, variant A - 9.78s, confirmed via 7 independent config/tts captures across ja-jp/sk-sk/af-za tags (with and without chime, different TTS categories)
5d24f381d523c595652a493a365c66a8: Homeway limit/quota response, variant B - 8.22s, distinct from variant A (different duration/hash, not just another locale-tag rotation), captured es-ar tagged
3b524eea5924e92812381e2435dfb1d3: Homeway limit/quota response, variant C - 7.56s, distinct from variants A and B, captured es-hn tagged
6768eab355a6021f8e97df01f78b0c0a: Homeway limit/quota response, variant D - 2.91s, notably shorter than variants A/B/C, captured es-bo tagged
83df8dfcb62d0a93649fd51a8cc3c529: Homeway limit/quota response, variant E - ~3.27s speech (4.31s combined with chime), found manually in the durable ttsbridge_chimes_cache rather than captured from config/tts - no locale tag available for this one
de8e166d9063abd395868ec0bc8d6f62: Homeway limit/quota response, variant F - 3.84s, captured tr-tr tagged immediately after deleting variant E's poisoned cache entry and re-resolving the same message fresh
7efad9ab8b1d173f0d3e9f0bf5411c6c: Homeway limit/quota response, variant G - 5.71s, confirmed via user review (forward collision, 2 distinct messages) - not a match for variants A-F
0c7fe2c0cd23c97b680a1352bb8af256: Homeway limit/quota response, variant H - 10.27s, auto-detected by the forward-collision system (ttsbridge_signature_log/log.json shows 3 separate message hashes tied to this exact signature, sample auto-archived at ttsbridge_signature_log/0c7fe2c0cd23c97b680a1352bb8af256.mp3) - a real, repeatedly-recurring variant, not a manual transcription
efa8e6bcce242fd914b1f70b4c26f385: Homeway limit/quota response, variant I - found by manual listening review of the durable chime cache. Same hash as the largest cluster (35 files) from the very first backup analysis early this session - was never converted from a combined-file cluster hash into a proper speech-only signature at the time, so it went undetectable until now. Two more clusters from that same original batch (8140fc739eaaebf08e03416cc81340e5, 179c58213b2c1b74acd5407091eb101f - both combined-file hashes, NOT yet re-derived as speech-only) are very likely still unregistered the same way.
6eb4524567975731d1e2adcb47dd8b86: Homeway limit/quota response, variant J - the 'f479551f...' combined-file cluster from the very first backup analysis, re-derived as a proper speech-only signature. Confirmed via two independent combined files (386b8c52..., b315f728...) both trimming to this exact hash - internally consistent, just never registered.
2ea8a7469c6f209dd67381e5644871bd: Homeway limit/quota response, variant K - found by deliberately re-testing whether a previously-poisoned message (originally variant I) would be caught again. Turned out to be a genuinely different, previously-unseen signature, not a repeat of variant I - confirming the scan tooling was working correctly all along; there was simply no match to catch yet.
